specs.Supported Application: Alarm, Find My Phone, Messages, Time Display, Weather
specs.Metrics Measured: Calories Burned, Distance, Heart Rate, Step Count

features: 1.85" Display with 400 nits brightness: Big, sharp and bright enough to read a message at noon without cupping your hand over the screen.
Functional Rotating Crown: Turn to scroll, press to select. Move through menus and workouts without a single swipe on the screen.
60+ Built-in Sports Modes: Every mode already sits on the watch, so you pick your sport and start moving without touching the app.
Noise Health Suite: Heart rate, SpO2, stress, sleep, steps, calories and female cycle tracking, all running through your day.
Bluetooth Calling: Dial pad, recent calls and up to 8 saved contacts on the wrist, so your phone can stay in your pocket.
